# Paths where the old names may still appear, checked by scripts/check-old-name.sh.
# One entry per line: `<git pathspec>  # <reason>[, <reason>] [(note)]`. Lines starting with # are
# comments. The guard fails on a line with no reason or one not listed here.
#
# Reasons:
#   money        "lukas"/"luka" is Colombian slang for money and stays (never the app or mascot name).
#   history      the plans and specs, and records of a move from an old name (a migration, the
#                one-time steps that move or delete something made under it).
#   docs-rule    agent maps (AGENTS.md) that name the old words in order to say they stay.
#   key-alias    the signing key's alias, which lives inside the key and cannot change.
# A file holding more than one kind lists them comma-joined (`money, history`). Directory globs are
# only for whole folders; everything else lists the files that have a hit.
# A file lists every reason for what remains in it.
